name: MQTT quality of service (QoS)
short_description: MQTT delivery levels that govern acknowledgement and retry between client and broker: QoS 0 (at most once), QoS 1 (at least once) and QoS 2 (exactly once); Azure IoT Hub supports QoS 0 and 1.

evidence.quote: MQTT supports quality of service levels that govern how sender and broker handle acknowledgement and retry.
